# gitmoap_user_by_email (Data Source)

Look up a user by email address. Returns the account registered with that exact address. Unlike the lookups by id and by username, it needs a signed-in caller.

The token needs `user:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_user_by_email" "example" {
  email = "ada@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address

### Read-Only

- `avatar` (String)
- `user_id` (String)
- `username` (String)
